rule: Clamp only the integer count of missing team reports to [earlier training minimum,earlier training maximum]. Refuse if an interior integer is absent from observed fit support, if support is ambiguous, or if input is invalid. Hold all other feature values and fitted parameters fixed. A clamped count is an extrapolation sensitivity, never new source evidence.
source_precedence: Accept exact training rows or uniquely identified support from the bound standardized feature moments. Historical out-of-fold fitting requires the exact feature-table digest in the archived fit audit. No substitute law or model.
